title: Arc-laid court setts
subject: Subject: a court paved with small squared stone setts laid in overlapping sweeping arcs (a fan pattern), about 3 m across, the arcs small and even so the pattern repeats many times in the square. Grey-blue stones, frost in the joints and a faint frosting on top. Cold moonlit colours.
use: The round court of the dead Moonwell.

title: Frosted garden earth
subject: Subject: the bare earth of a winter garden bed, about 2 m across. Dark soil and a few dead leaves under a thin, broken crust of snow and frost, small even patches of white over blue-black earth, no plants. Cold moonlit colours.
use: The walled garden beds in the corners of the Moonwell's court.

title: Frosted castle stone
subject: Subject: a castle wall of cut stone blocks, seen straight on, about 2.5 m across. Rectangular pale grey and grey-blue blocks of slightly varied sizes in even mortared courses, chipped edges, white frost in the joints. Moonlit night colours.
use: The walls, towers and buildings of the north: the dead Moonwell, Misthollow, the shipyard and the crossroads' ruins.

title: The dead Moonwell
subject: Subject: the dead Moonwell, seen flat from the side: a wide round well of pale grey fitted stones on a low round dais of two stone steps, a carved band round its side showing crescent moons and a moth with spread wings in the middle, its rim of big curved stones. Over it a dark iron frame: two posts with spiked finials joined by a twisted, branch-like iron arch, with an iron ring and two hanging chains. A little frost on the stones. The well is dead: no light. The whole well is in the picture.
use: The centre of the dead Moonwell's court, where the final battle is.

title: The Moonwell's carved band
subject: Subject: a stretch of carved stone band, seen flat from the front, about 3 m long and 0.8 m tall: dark grey-blue stone with a moth with spread wings carved in the middle and crescent moons either side, between thin moulded edges, worn and frosted. The whole stretch is in the picture.
use: Wrapped round the side of the dead Moonwell.

title: The Moonwell's north door
subject: Subject: the front of a keep, seen flat from the front: pale grey stone wall with a tall pointed arched doorway with a carved stone surround and a dark double wooden door with iron rings, four stone steps up to it, a stone pillar with a spiked iron finial each side, and a navy banner with a pale crescent moon hanging on the wall either side. The whole front is in the picture.
use: The north side of the dead Moonwell's court.

title: Round court tower
subject: Subject: a round tower of pale grey stone blocks, seen flat from the front: crenellated top with snow on the merlons, a moulded band below them and another lower down, narrow arched windows, and a navy banner with a pale crescent moon hung from an iron bar. The whole tower is in the picture.
use: The two round towers by the dead Moonwell's entrance.

title: Crescent moon banner
subject: Subject: a hanging cloth banner, seen flat from the front, about 1 m wide and 2.5 m long: deep navy cloth with a pale silver crescent moon low in the middle, a small faint silver pattern near the top, and a swallow-tailed lower edge, hung from a black iron bar. Soft folds only.
use: On the towers and walls of the dead Moonwell's court.

title: Arched tower door
subject: Subject: a doorway, seen flat from the front: a pointed arch of pale cut stone blocks round a dark wooden double door with iron bands and ring handles, a stone step at its foot, a little frost on the stones. The whole doorway is in the picture.
use: The doors of the towers and buildings round the dead Moonwell's court.

title: Frost-white shrub
subject: Subject: one leafless shrub, about 2 m tall, seen from the side, whole, with its base at the bottom. Many thin dark upright twigs, each furred with white frost and tiny snow flecks, a small snowy mound at its foot. Cold moonlit colours.
use: In the gardens and planters round the dead Moonwell's court.
